patch_resolves_note: The staged `patch.diff` does not apply to the Stage 01 checkout and does not touch `include/flatbuffers/util.h` or the empty-input parser path. The authoritative fixed evidence therefore comes from the `n132/arvo:42502006-fix` fallback image, whose cleanliness does not correspond to a source patch in this bug path.

root_cause_criterion.description: Before `ss << t;` formats the integer argument, the bytes of the local `std::stringstream ss` object consumed by that insertion must already be initialized. The vulnerable run reaches the insertion with only a prefix of `ss` initialized, matching the saved MSan origin on stack object `ss`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable assertion trace violates the frozen predicate at `num_to_string_ss_root` (`32 < 280`) while `num_to_string_insert_sink` executes. The authoritative fixed fallback image is clean but still reaches the same protected event with the predicate false (`124 < 280`), so the fixed-side cleanliness is not evidence of a source-level repair to the missing initialization obligation.

nodes.description: At the source-level sink `ss << t;`, the local stream object `ss` still has an initialized prefix smaller than `sizeof(ss)` on the vulnerable execution.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `num_to_string_insert_sink.ss_object_bytes=280` and `ss_initialized_prefix_len=32` immediately before the MSan crash.

edges.description: The same stack-allocated `ss` object observed at the root event is the receiver consumed by the immediately following `ss << t` sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `num_to_string_ss_root.ss_object_addr == num_to_string_insert_sink.ss_object_addr == 0x7fff5d517998`.
